fields.name: vertex
fields.doc: false = ignore the shader's `fn vertex` (engine vertex stage, plain depth: early depth testing stays on)

fields.name: [string]
fields.doc: `shader.<param>` reads / writes a field of `struct Params` in the WGSL code (any name).

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Point or spot (Luau: `light.type`, `"point"` / `"spot"`).

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Light color.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc:
Brightness multiplier (0 = off). Negative values are clamped to 0.
At least 0.

fields.name: range
fields.doc:
Distance in meters where the light has faded out completely. Values below 0.01 are clamped.
At least 0.01 m.

fields.name: shadows
fields.doc: Casts shadows (a cube shadow map, see `RenderSettings::light_shadows`).

fields.name: angle
fields.doc:
Full cone angle of a spot light in degrees, 1 to 179 (new spot lights: 45).
Used by "spot".

fields.name: softness
fields.doc:
0..1 = blurry edge.
Range 0 to 1.
Used by "spot".

fields.name: x
fields.doc: shortcuts for position.x / .y / .z

fields.name: body
fields.doc: physics (see "Physics"): `nil` / false removes the body; the scalars (mass, velocity, ...) are generated below

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Name shown in the hierarchy and used by `find(name)`.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc:
Drawn (children inherit it being off).
Default true.

fields.name: position
fields.doc:
Position in meters.
Unit: m. Default vec3(0, 0, 0).

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Rotation as Euler angles in radians: (pitch, yaw, roll) = rotation around X, Y, Z, applied Y, then X, then Z. Relative to the parent.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc:
Scale per axis (1 = original size).
Default vec3(1, 1, 1).

fields.name: mesh
fields.doc:
The mesh drawn (a runtime handle).
Default "runtime:mesh/0".

fields.name: lod
fields.doc: Level of detail: from each distance on the renderer draws that mesh instead of `mesh`.

fields.name: color
fields.doc:
Base color (multiplied with the texture).
Default rgba(1, 1, 1, 1).

fields.name: shader
fields.doc: Custom surface shader (`nil` = the engine default).

fields.name: data
fields.doc:
Free per-material numbers for custom shaders (`object.data` in WGSL).
Default vec4(0, 0, 0, 0).

fields.name: blend
fields.doc:
Blending with the background (see `BlendMode`).
Default "auto".

fields.name: double_sided
fields.doc:
Draw back faces too (leaves, flags, planes seen from below).
Default false.

fields.name: cast_shadow
fields.doc:
Casts a shadow from the sun (`RenderSettings::shadows`).
Default true.

fields.name: pbr
fields.doc:
Physically based shading (Cook-Torrance GGX with `metallic` / `roughness`) instead of the
classic diffuse look. Turned on by `Material::pbr`, `with_metallic`, `with_roughness`.
Default false.

fields.name: metallic
fields.doc:
0 = dielectric (plastic, wood, stone), 1 = metal. Used when `pbr` is on. Out-of-range values are clamped
(like `Material::with_metallic`, which also turns `pbr` on; writing the field alone does not).
Range 0 to 1. Default 0.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc:
0 = mirror-smooth, 1 = fully rough. Used when `pbr` is on. Out-of-range values are clamped
(like `Material::with_roughness`, which also turns `pbr` on; writing the field alone does not).
Range 0 to 1. Default 0.5.

fields.name: emissive
fields.doc:
Light the surface emits by itself, added after lighting (black = none). Works in every mode.
Default rgba(0, 0, 0, 1).

fields.name: normal_map
fields.doc: Tangent-space normal map (OpenGL convention: green points along +V). Works with and without `pbr`.

fields.name: orm_map
fields.doc:
Packed surface data (used when `pbr` is on): R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metallic; each is
multiplied with `roughness` / `metallic`. Like the normal map it holds data, not colors.

fields.name: mass
fields.doc:
Total mass in kg. Assigning `nil` lets the physics engine compute it from the volume (density 1).
Greater than 0.

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc:
Sensors detect overlaps (collision events) but don't push anything.
Default false.

fields.name: gravity_scale
fields.doc:
Multiplier of the world gravity for this body (0 = floats, negative = rises).
Default 1.

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc:
World-space velocity (m/s). Written back by the simulation; set it to change it.
Unit: m/s. Default vec3(0, 0, 0).

fields.name: angular_velocity
fields.doc:
World-space angular velocity (rad/s).
Unit: rad/s. Default vec3(0, 0, 0).

methods.name: on
methods.doc: events and timers owned by the object

Function.name: load
Function.doc:
Creates the objects of a `.scene` and returns its root objects. `replace = true` deletes the current objects first
and applies the file's sun / ambient / background / fog / sky; the default adds to the scene.
Writes every object and the environment to a `.scene` (not in a packed game). Returns warnings about changes to
prefab instances that a file cannot hold (empty when there are none); anything else that cannot be saved is an error.

Field.name: shader
Field.doc: Shader, list of Shaders / { shader = s, size = "screen" | "scene" }, or nil

Field.name: post
Field.doc: built-in post effects: nil / false = off, true = defaults, table = settings

fields.doc: Drawn (children inherit it being off).

components.name: transform
components.doc: Local position, rotation and scale of an [Object] (relative to its parent, or the world).

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Position in meters.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc:
Rotation, reflected as Euler angles in degrees (pitch, yaw, roll; Y-X-Z order). The scripting API
uses radians for the same angles.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Scale per axis (1 = original size).

components.name: mesh
components.doc:
The mesh an object draws and its level-of-detail meshes (`Object::mesh`, `Object::lod`). Present when the object
has a mesh. Read-only for now: meshes are runtime handles until mesh recipes exist (step C-11).

fields.name: mesh
fields.doc: The mesh drawn (a runtime handle).

fields.name: lod
fields.doc: Level of detail: from each distance on the renderer draws that mesh instead of `mesh`.

components.name: material
components.doc: How a mesh looks. Lit by the sun + ambient unless `unlit`.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Base color (multiplied with the texture).

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: Base color texture (a runtime handle; no scene-file form until assets have paths).

fields.name: tiling
fields.doc: Texture repeats across the surface (e.g. `(4, 4)` on a ground plane).

fields.name: unlit
fields.doc: Ignore lighting: shows the exact color (UI, glowing things, sprites).

fields.name: shader
fields.doc: Surface shader (`None` = [`crate::RenderSettings::shader`], else the engine default).

fields.name: data
fields.doc: Free per-material numbers for custom shaders (`object.data` in WGSL).

fields.name: blend
fields.doc: Blending with the background (see [`BlendMode`]).

variants.name: opaque
variants.doc: Solid; pixels with alpha < 0.01 are cut out (foliage, fences).

variants.name: alpha
variants.doc: See-through (glass, water, fading objects). Drawn after opaque objects, back to front.

variants.name: additive
variants.doc: Adds light (fire, lasers, glow). Drawn with the transparent objects.

fields.name: double_sided
fields.doc: Draw back faces too (leaves, flags, planes seen from below).

fields.name: cast_shadow
fields.doc: Casts a shadow from the sun (`RenderSettings::shadows`).

fields.name: pbr
fields.doc:
Physically based shading (Cook-Torrance GGX with `metallic` / `roughness`) instead of the
classic diffuse look. Turned on by [`Material::pbr`], `with_metallic`, `with_roughness`.

fields.name: metallic
fields.doc:
0 = dielectric (plastic, wood, stone), 1 = metal. Used when `pbr` is on. Out-of-range values are clamped
(like [`Material::with_metallic`], which also turns `pbr` on; writing the field alone does not).

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc:
0 = mirror-smooth, 1 = fully rough. Used when `pbr` is on. Out-of-range values are clamped
(like [`Material::with_roughness`], which also turns `pbr` on; writing the field alone does not).

fields.name: emissive
fields.doc: Light the surface emits by itself, added after lighting (black = none). Works in every mode.

fields.name: normal_map
fields.doc: Tangent-space normal map (OpenGL convention: green points along +V). Works with and without `pbr`.

fields.name: orm_map
fields.doc:
Packed surface data (used when `pbr` is on): R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metallic; each is
multiplied with `roughness` / `metallic`. Like the normal map it holds data, not colors.

components.name: body
components.doc: A rigid body attached to an object (`Object::body`).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How the body moves.

variants.name: dynamic
variants.doc: Moved by the simulation (gravity, collisions, impulses).

variants.name: static
variants.doc: Never moves on its own (ground, walls). You can still teleport it.

variants.name: kinematic
variants.doc: Moved only by your code (position / rotation); pushes dynamic bodies.

fields.name: shape
fields.doc: Collision shape in the object's local space.

variants.name: auto
variants.doc:
Derived from the mesh: box / sphere / cylinder for primitives, triangle mesh (static,
kinematic) or convex hull (dynamic) for custom meshes.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Full size (width, height, depth).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius of the caps and the body.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Total height including the caps.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height.

fields.name: mass
fields.doc: Total mass in kg. `None` = computed from volume (density 1).

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: Surface friction (0 = ice).

fields.name: bounciness
fields.doc: 0 = no bounce, 1 = perfectly elastic.

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc: Sensors detect overlaps (collision events) but don't push anything.

fields.name: lock_rotation
fields.doc: Keeps the body upright (characters).

fields.name: gravity_scale
fields.doc: Multiplier of the world gravity for this body (0 = floats, negative = rises).

fields.name: linear_damping
fields.doc: Slows the linear velocity down over time.

fields.name: angular_damping
fields.doc: Slows the rotation down over time.

fields.name: ccd
fields.doc: Continuous collision detection for fast objects (bullets).

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: World-space velocity (m/s). Written back by the simulation; set it to change it.

fields.name: angular_velocity
fields.doc: World-space angular velocity (rad/s).

fields.name: impulse
fields.doc: Impulse applied at the next physics step, then reset.

fields.name: torque_impulse
fields.doc: Angular impulse applied at the next physics step, then reset.

fields.name: force
fields.doc: Force applied during the next physics step, then reset (call every fixed_update).

components.name: light
components.doc:
Point or spot light attached to an object. Reaches exactly `range` meters (smooth falloff).

The `lua` names of its fields are members of the Luau `obj.light` handle (`obj.light.intensity`), not of the
object itself (`obj.color` is the material color).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Point or spot (Luau: `light.type`, `"point"` / `"spot"`).

fields.name: angle
fields.doc: Full cone angle in radians (the scripting API uses degrees, 1 to 179).

fields.name: softness
fields.doc: 0..1 = blurry edge.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Light color.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Brightness multiplier (0 = off). Negative values are clamped to 0.

fields.name: range
fields.doc: Distance in meters where the light has faded out completely. Values below 0.01 are clamped.

fields.name: shadows
fields.doc: Casts shadows (a cube shadow map, see `RenderSettings::light_shadows`).
